<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1:3">Cant. R. to II, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00103"><he>חֲבַצֶּלֶת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>המשובח שבמינים כש׳ … שׁוֹשַׁנַּת העמקים</he> (the righteous are compared to) the most precious of the various kinds (of flowers), to the lily, and to the finest of that species which is the lily of the valley.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>שושנת ההר</he> the mountain lily.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>, beg., a. e. <he>כש׳ אדומה</he> like a red lily (euphem. for light menstruation).
Kil. V, 8 שושנת המלך the king’s lily (κρίνον βασιλικόν), white lily; Tosef. ib. III, 13. Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ, v. כַּרְמֶל; a. fr.—Trnsf. knob of a nail.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:4">Num. R. s. 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01969"><he>מִסְמָר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite>.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 459">Yalk. Lev. 459</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00567"><he>שׁוֹשָׁטָה</he></cite>.]
